item.title: No Cables, 5X Cheaper: Reimaging India’s Internet
item.description: What if high-speed internet could reach villages where even roads struggle to go? While cities stream at 5G speeds, thousands of remote villages in India still have no internet network at all. Why? Because traditional fibre is slow, expensive, and incredibly tough to deploy in remote terrain. Enter Astrome and its breakthrough technology, GigaMesh—the world's first multi-beam E-band radio system that delivers fibre-like internet wirelessly at 1/5th the cost.
